notes: Intake deadline: DAAD says the winter-semester application deadline is 15 July for applicants from all countries, but gives no year, so it is stored as a recurring deadline. TU Chemnitz's own page gives a dated deadline (15 July 2026) for Bachelor 1st semester, but it does not say who it is for (international/non-EU), and the extended 31 August deadline applies only to EU/EWR/Switzerland applicants and is explicitly not for those needing a Studienkolleg, so it is not used. Tuition: DAAD states tuition fees per semester are none; the TU Chemnitz leaflet says the university does not charge any tuition fee. The semester contribution (approx. EUR 340.50 per DAAD / EUR 341.40 as of winter semester 2026/2027 per the leaflet) is not a tuition fee. Languages: the two evidence quotes refer to the teaching of the two halves of the programme. For the German language requirements the accepted-certificate lists name e.g. telc Deutsch A1 and Goethe A1 for admission, and DSH-1, TestDaF 3/3/3/3, Goethe B2, ÖSD B2, telc B2 for the preparatory course; no test list was extracted for the A2 rule because no quote names specific A2 certificates. The DAAD page also lists TOEIC 785/P TE Academic 59/Cambridge B2 First/UNIcert II/telc English B2 as accepted English certificates in addition to IELTS/TOEFL. The subject_taken rule was not extracted because no quote names a required school subject with a mode for this programme; the programme's mathematics/physics contents are university-level modules, not admission subjects.

note.fr: Vérifiez si votre diplôme de fin d'études secondaires équivaut au baccalauréat allemand (Abitur). Sinon, un Studienkolleg avec Feststellungsprüfung (FSP) peut être exigé avant le début des études.
note.en: Check whether your secondary school diploma is equivalent to the German Abitur. If not, a Studienkolleg with a Feststellungsprüfung (FSP) may be required before starting your studies.

evidence.quote: If your foreign high school diploma is not equivalent to the German high school diploma, you must complete a preparatory course for university studies ("Studienkolleg") in Germany before beginning your studies

note.fr: Des connaissances d'allemand au niveau A2 (CECR) sont fortement recommandées en plus du A1 exigé.
note.en: German language skills at A2 level (CEFR) are strongly recommended in addition to the required A1.
